announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l1 — wakeup tasks and hardening
announcements.summary: Adds scheduled wakeup tasks, safer persistence, request cancellation, and upstream 0.1.21 packaging compatibility.
announcements.content:
This release ports the upstream Wakeup capability and hardens the local build.
1. Wakeup: schedule daily, weekly, fixed-interval, quota-reset, and after-startup tasks for all accounts or individual accounts.
2. Dashboard: configure, enable, disable, run, and inspect Wakeup tasks from the global clock or account cards without switching the active auth.json.
3. Reliability: preserve caller cancellation, cover response-body reads with request timeouts, and use locked, atomic, permission-restricted private storage.
4. Packaging: align with upstream 0.1.21 icon requirements and dependency updates.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l1 — 定时唤醒与加固
zh.summary: 新增定时唤醒任务、更加安全的持久化、请求取消和上游 0.1.21 打包兼容性。
zh.content:
本地版本移植上游 Wakeup 功能，并加固扩展运行时。
1. 定时唤醒：支持每日、每周、固定间隔、额度重置和启动后触发，可作用于全部账号或单个账号。
2. Dashboard：可从全局时钟或账号卡片配置、启停、立即执行和查看唤醒任务，不会切换当前生效的 auth.json。
3. 可靠性：保留调用方取消语义，让响应体读取受请求超时保护，并使用带文件锁、原子写入和受限权限的私有存储。
4. 打包：对齐上游 0.1.21 的图标要求和依赖更新。
